reviews.text: The team here was great from start to finish. I loved that Jay designed a pool based on our backyard that definitely looks as if it has been there from the beginning. The pool colors to choose from were absolutely stunning. Hats off to all the workers, Jay, and Curtis for answering all the questions I had. This was my very first time building a pool and it was amazing! I truly enjoyed the excitement of it all. My family and I  thank you so much for making a dream our reality!!! 💕
reviews.author: tameka williams

reviews.text: We recently hired DFW Custom Pool to do a refresher on our pool which was last remodeled in 2009.  The pool needed to be replastered and some of the coping reset. The decking also needed new mastic. DFW did a great job. The job was supervised  by Eric who was very responsive in answering questions and addressing any issues that arose. DFW also got it done in just a few weeks which wasn't easy because we had a lot of rain while they were trying to do the job. DFW also redid my law partners pool.  He recommended them to me.  I also highly recommend them to anyone else needing to update/refresh the look of their pool!
reviews.author: George Boll

reviews.text: Absolutely loved working with DFW Custom Pools! Mitch was amazing to work with, really understood what we wanted, and helped us to design our dream backyard. Our project manager, Kurtis, went above and beyond to make our dream a reality. During the build process, Kurtis was always very responsive to any questions we had and proactive about letting us know about scheduling or scheduling changes. We’ve gotten so many compliments from friends and family, and would highly recommend DFW Custom Pools if you’re wanting a turn-key, custom job!
reviews.author: Brittany Bachelor

reviews.text: DFW Custom Pool did a great job in installing our pool and working with other contractors to make sure everything works together and the pool was ready to go in less than 90 days. Kurtis has been especially helpful and responds to our questions promptly. Thanks for everything!
reviews.author: Mark Ritchie

reviews.text: Gene and his crew did a great job on our pool. Highly recommended. They work with you after the install as well. We had a LED light issue and they took care of all the warranty issues the following week.
reviews.author: Carl Plaxco

reviews.text:
Not up to my standards, but the pool is functionalI, if you are the type of person that is ok with someone using caulk to fix a crack on a new granite counter, then this is your company. Everything is paid upfront; you are left alone and in the dark, once it has water. The company was supposed to tend to the pool for the first bit, have never had anyone come check the pool. ( except for the joke of a pool school as they call it) The decking was 4” short of matching the existing porch, and drawing. with significant gaps between pavers most have been fixed. Paver crew isn’t bad other than, never knowing when they’re going to be here. Chalk line stains everywhere.Plaster left behind on expensive glass tile. Now it looks faded in some places, and covered with plaster.. Now, I’m going to have to pay a professional to clean up the plaster. mud stains on the bottom . I had already had to clean up after construction myself. They were to direct rain water flow around the pool. It is directly in the pool. Still have to clean pencil measuring marks off the stone, and the glue is the worst. I had to clean the house inside and out because of dust. I was told the outside would have been pressure washed on clean-up. It was highly recommended to use Ludder stone; it was a horrible decision; stained and has already cracked. All this and have not even got a final city Inspection yet.Very disappointed. Getting something done after water is in the pool is impossible, probably because everything has been paid. The retainer wall is cracked and falling. I Personally had to show them That they had not poured any other cells when I build the retaining wall. Even though they installed rebar. Met with the owner of the pool company he showed his sub, what to do and They still do not fix it correctly. You personally have to babysit them. You can see by the pictures what kind of work has been done.
Promised they would put the fence back if they cut the bracing, and I would never know They removed it. (Welding skills in picture) Not even close.
I do have to give props to Derrick as a Forman, I also understand many things are out of his control. The company is only as good as it’s subcontractors. See pictures below!!

GOOD FROM FAR, FAR FROM GOOD
reviews.author: Marcus Cleveland

reviews.text: They do go away.  Trying to get service for items still under warranty, you are ignored.  You also have to stay on top of them while they built the pool to make sure they are using the correct equipment and building it correctly. The pool is wonderful but if any issues occur after final payment, they won't get resolved.
reviews.author: Chocovamp Onlydark

reviews.text: We hired Gene to remodel our pool on a recommendation from a neighbor down the street. We had it resurfaced and new tile installed. It was immaculately refinished, the tile is exactly what I envisioned, and the work was completed quickly. We have had other contractors work on our property before and it was a complete nightmare. He made me trust contractors again -- the work was done on time and the subs were good workers and didn't leave a huge mess. His prices are also at least 5-10K less than other local pool companies for remodeling. I'd rec him in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Sally Loisel

data.summary: The contractor's Local Google reviews appear authentic and detailed, showing a mix of very satisfied and moderately dissatisfied customers with specific feedback. However, the Google HQ profile is filled with fake/spam listings, and Yelp shows suspicious snippets. A clear pattern of post-payment/warranty service complaints exists alongside positive project management experiences.
fake_signals: Google HQ profile contains 7 anonymous, non-descriptive 'reviews' that are just business listings or addresses
Multiple HQ 'reviews' posted with unknown dates and no content
Yelp search results show irrelevant snippets, suggesting potential review manipulation or spam

negative_evidence: Chocovamp Onlydark review: 'Trying to get service for items still under warranty, you are ignored'
Marcus Cleveland review mentions lack of promised post-installation pool tending
positive_evidence: Carl Plaxco review: 'they took care of all the warranty issues the following week'

authentic_signals: Local Google reviews contain specific project details (names: Jay, Curtis, Eric, Mitch, Gene; project types: new build, replaster, coping reset)
Varied writing styles and perspectives across reviews
Mix of 5-star praise and 3-4 star reviews with constructive criticism
Specific complaints with details (e.g., decking 4" short, caulk on counter, ignored warranty requests)
complaint_patterns: Lack of communication after final payment
